title: Best Bookshelf (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Selections were based on the PCMag, RTINGS, CNET, and TechGearLab reviews, prioritizing products mentioned by multiple sources and noting their strengths and drawbacks.
assumptions: Prices are omitted because none of the sources provide them.

verdict.line: Picture a living room where music flows from a sleek, wall‑mounted speaker that doubles as a shelf. The IKEA SYMFONISK delivers balanced mid‑range sound, integrates with Sonos and Apple AirPlay 2, and is affordable for a first entry into multi‑room audio. Its main catch is that the bracket for wall mounting is not included.
